patch_description: A deterministic population-based maximin optimizer for 13-point Heilbronn configurations. The construction fixes an equilateral triangular convex hull and represents all remaining points by barycentric coordinates, which guarantees every candidate remains inside the hull. It combines batched evolutionary proposals, differential moves, bottleneck-triangle targeted perturbations, periodic diversity-preserving restarts, and a final local active-set polish. The vectorized triangle evaluator scores all 286 triangles for many layouts simultaneously, substantially improving search breadth while retaining deterministic reproducibility.
